body: Keychain lookups must name the account: claude.Keychain.Get asks `security find-generic-password -s 'Claude Code-credentials' -a <macOS username>` first (what Claude Code writes), then falls back. Never go back to a service-only lookup: stale same-service entries (account `unknown`, empty token, expiresAt 0) exist on real machines and are returned first. Guarded by TestKeychainGet_PrefersAccount (fixed 2026-09-25, 2d59cd2, released v0.2.1). Diagnose with `security dump-keychain | grep -B8 'Claude Code-credentials'`.
